The '''Gholondreine''' were the inhabitants of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gholondreine-β]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. During the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], they continued to adhere steadfastly to the ideals of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], for which they were brutally [[Desiccation of Gholondreine-β|punished]] by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].

==History==
===The voice of truth===
[[File:Gholondreine.jpg|left|thumb|260px|The cities and towns of Gholondreine-ẞ were known for their scholars and philosophers]]
The Gholondreine people were the natives of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gholondreine-β]]<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="EU" /> located in the [[Gholondreine system/Legends|eponymous star system]], within the [[Chitarghar sector/Legends|Chitarghar sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Their society was united in the coastal and inland [[Democracy/Legends|democracies]] across the planet's landmasses.<ref name="SS" /> Their [[City/Legends|cities]] and towns were known for producing renowned [[Scholar/Legends|scholars]] and [[Philosopher/Legends|philosophers]], who held that all [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings owed their highest loyalty to truth, however painfully temporal authorities might challenge that allegiance.<ref name="TEA" />

===Imperial retribution===
{{Quote|Standard operating procedure for the Empire. Especially when the Emperor's in his punitive mode.|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], to [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]]|<ref name="SS" />}}
[[File:Emperor_Palpatine_AoN.png|thumb|right|220px|Emperor Palpatine exacted brutal retribution on the inhabitants of Gholondreine-ẞ for their disobedience]]
Their position remained steadfast even after the [[Declaration of the New Order|proclamation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and Gholondreine's inhabitants were reluctant to implement the changes of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].<ref name="SS" /><ref name="CE">{{CSWECite|I|338|Gholondreine-b}}</ref> Academics across the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] have been deeply alarmed by the atrocities committed by the forces of the Empire. However, most were too frightened to make their voices heard. Meanwhile, in [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]], a number of Gholondreine [[Scholar/Legends|scholars]] published urgent and scathing critiques of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]'s rule.<ref name="EU" /> When they persisted, the Emperor decided to make an example of their world.<ref name="TEA" />

The [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of Gholondreine-ẞ<ref name="SS" /><ref name="CE" /> were swiftly<ref name="EU" /> [[Desiccation of Gholondreine-β|sucked down]] to the last molecule of [[Water/Legends|water]],<ref name="SS" /><ref name="TEA" /> then transported by a fleet of massive Imperial [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] to an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] catalysis plant near [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="SS" /> which served as the «Imperial Center».<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> Economy had not been the motivating factor – it had been more expensive to ship that amount of water than to synthesize it – but punishment had been.<ref name="SS" /> This atrocity forced most residents to escape the dying world,<ref name="CE" /> leaving behind only deserted [[City/Legends|cities]]. Neighboring worlds in this sector received a valuable object lesson in how to respond to the Emperor's commands.<ref name="SS" />

===Pitiful refugees===
{{Quote|There're some refugee colonies of Gholondreine-β natives on the surrounding system worlds, but they won't be coming back to their homeworld for a long time. Palpatine's seen to that.|Boba Fett, to Bossk|<ref name="SS" />}}
The Gholondreine scholars who survived the devastation became pitiful [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]], often forced to rely on the support of their peers in other centers of learning.<ref name="EU" /> Elsewhere, Gholondreine exiles established some refugee [[Colonist/Legends|colonies]] on the surrounding [[Star system/Legends|system]] worlds, but Palpatine decreed that they would not be allowed to return to their homeworld for a long time.<ref name="SS" /> The dead world was seeded with [[Ithorian crawler]]s<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="EU" /> that were designed to exude a long-lasting [[Poison/Legends|biotoxin]] into the soil.<ref name="SS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The first mention of the inhabitants of Gholondreine-ẞ and their tragic fate appeared in the second novel of ''[[The Bounty Hunter Wars]]'' trilogy, ''[[Slave Ship]]'', written by [[K. W. Jeter]] and published in [[October]] [[1998]] by [[Bantam Spectra]].<ref name="SS" /> Later, various sourcebooks slightly expanded their history.<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="CE" /><ref name="EU" />
